text.p: Kronos Inc said Wednesday its board had approved a stock repurchase program covering up to 500,000 shares.
The company, reporting earnings per share of $0.21 for the fiscal second quarter against $0.28 a year earlier, also said it was looking to expand overseas.

"International sales are ...a key to our future," it said. "Last quarter we recruited several new country managers and senior directors for our international division and expect that we will begin to establish an even stronger presence in key markets around the world."
The company has 8.4 million average common and common equivalent shares outstanding, fully diluted.
Kronos makes business software and hardware systems that help managers produce employee schedules and track worker productivity on the shop floor.
